data_descriptions.v1: Version 1 synthetic data: provider, patient and claim tables with a stored chronic-condition count, plus a records-review sample (documentation.csv, about 30% of claims) handed to the AI up front.
data_descriptions.v2: Version 2 synthetic data: plan-shaped tables (members, providers, claim headers and lines, remittance with denials, replacements and voids); conditions derived from claims; charts only by records request (limited, late or missing responses, coder disagreement); separate MDM elements and minutes; some upcoders clone their notes.
data_descriptions.v2.1: Version 2.1 synthetic data: the version 2 plan-shaped tables (claims and records universe identical to 2.0 for the same seed) plus the note package a records request returns (note text, signatures, orders and results, an EHR audit trail).

seed_status_meaning: development = the seed used to build and tune the workflow (screen cutoff, rule thresholds); held-out = generated or scored after those settings were frozen.
